posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: I ran this against the Q2 FY27 numbers, annualised. Net operating income is 7.62% of average assets, opex 5.33%, credit cost 1.02%, tax 25.7%. That gives an ROA of 0.94% (the bank reports 0.93%), and at 9.2x leverage an RoE of about 8.7%. Holding everything else fixed and moving only cost-to-income and credit cost: Cost-to-income Credit cost 1.0% (now) Credit cost 0.8% 70% (now) 8.7% 10.2% 65% 11.3% 12.8% 60% 13.9% 15.4% So 13% at 65% also needs credit cost down to about 0.8%.
